science_question: Can heterogeneous station×date-pair baseline phase shapes correlated with overall branch-rate change make pooled time-bin model predict a false season-by-time interaction, while exact within-stratum conditioning remains calibrated?
geometry: Already solar-phase-normalized, equal full-day observation exposure; this is a different failure mechanism from equation-of-time aliasing

estimators.pooled: Existing ODSP six-bin conditional binomial null vs shape (lambda=2) fits training station cells; heldout sites only, 41*6 original cells/site denominator including unobserved other pairs, shape selected when gain>0 (NOT alpha-calibrated)
estimators.partial_pooling: Penalized logistic beta-binomial cell likelihood with one site-pair intercept per training site and Gaussian log-rate shrinkage; intercept ridge lambda_u=0.2 and lambda_u=10, global six-bin ridge=2. Only descriptive fitted global shape range, not a valid calibrated test nor heldout source-population estimate.
estimators.exact_conditioning: Heldout site×date-pair bin totals M_ik and branch total D_i conditioned upon; under within-pair phase-invariance yD vector is central multivariate hypergeometric over M. Test statistic sum_k [(sum_i(yDik-Di*Mik/Mi))^2 / (sum_i Var_hypergeo(yDik)+1e-12)] when data has conditional support; Monte Carlo p=(1+#{Tperm>=Tobs})/(1+99) with 99 null draws, alpha=0.05, no split tuning. Conditioning excludes only sites with uninformative zero variance, never redefines site roster.

controls: all pairs retain their 6 bins and any unobserved other 40 pairs remain in denominator
within each stratum the null scenarios have EXACTLY same phase rate shape on both branches, only branch-wide multiplier allowed
aggregate early vs late nonuniformity correlated with differing branch multipliers
actual event counts sampled independently with fixed seed and strict physical site assignment
stratum-conditional simulated p-values valid under both null worlds
homogeneous null contrast and true alternative retained, zero and unfavorable outcomes reported
no post-outcome change to input, conditional statistic, permutation count or threshold
results: partial pooling global bin-beta max-minus-min per penalty
number of theoretically true shape-null strata
Monte Carlo standard error for frequencies
interpretation: Mixed estimands: pooled criterion is a heldout predictive choice, partial pooling a non-calibrated descriptive fit, exact conditional permutation a level-0.05 test of within-stratum phase-shape invariance. Do not compare percentages as identical type-I error procedures.
